supersedes.reason: campaign 4 (b5c2457, manifest rev 4) finished 2026-10-12: 1,336 KILLED / 42 SURVIVED for its 28 targets; the V2.1 record read 12,333 KILLED / 222 SURVIVED over 469 targets, MUTATION_VERDICT FAIL for nine mutants that were the owner's decisions. The owner decided them on 2026-10-12 (docs/v2.1/decisions/B03-R3-*.md): the write policy of confine._judge and the locale of confine.measure; the domain of usage.no_progress and the journal boundary of --verify; the 1,500-character bound and the artifact of review_verify.detail; the concurrent release of ProcessRange. Their verification found and fixed defects in the measuring instrument itself — aisef2/runtime/process_range.py (a ps row cut at U+2028; a non-UTF-8 process name) and validation/v2/cleanup_authority.py (the ownership root could be forged by a command line) — so the harness pins changed. Nine product modules changed and 41 names are new targets (process_range.py and cleanup_authority.py join the record). The delta against b5c2457 (read-set of 161 kill files at 9f336fb) lets 358 of 528 targets stand by the proof's rules, but the measured reach of the kill files (campaign-5/reach.json) shows every one of them executes a changed function or runs a Python child the recorder cannot see, and the 196 probe-module targets import ProcessRange directly: there is no specific dependency basis for any standing result, so all 528 targets (13,566 mutants) are measured at this snapshot. Campaign 4's record stays as history.
